svg.title: Inbox prompt flow
svg.desc: Rune sends the registered Inbox question to the Embedded companion through its private Unix socket. Admission checks permissions and builds a fresh workstation snapshot and up to two prior exchanges. Explicit operational questions are answered directly from the snapshot. Broad or conversational turns use a durable queue and one sandboxed Rust-BERT generator with cached incremental decoding. Provisional chunks travel back by cursor. The coordinator checks operational facts and persists validated final text and timestamped citations. Inbox replaces its draft with the canonical reply and shows the model context dial.
